items.source: For most processing scenarios, simply use perform(RequestBuilder), or if you need to configure the DispatcherServlet, provide a DispatcherServletCustomizer to the MockMvcBuilder.
items.translation: 对于大多数处理场景，只需使用 perform(RequestBuilder)；如果需要配置 DispatcherServlet，则向 MockMvcBuilder 提供一个 DispatcherServletCustomizer。

items.source: This is intended for use in custom request processing scenario where a request handling component happens to delegate to the DispatcherServlet at runtime and therefore needs to be injected with it.
items.translation: 此设计旨在用于自定义请求处理场景，其中请求处理组件在运行时委托给 `<code>DispatcherServlet`》，因此需要将其注入。

items.source:
Main entry point for server-side Spring MVC test support.

Example

import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.*;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.*;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.setup.MockMvcBuilders.*;

// ...

WebApplicationContext wac = ...;

MockMvc mockMvc = webAppContextSetup(wac).build();

mockMvc.perform(get("/form"))
    .andExpectAll(
        status().isOk(),
        content().contentType("text/html"),
        forwardedUrl("/WEB-INF/layouts/main.jsp")
    );
items.translation:
服务端 Spring MVC 测试支持的主入口点。

mockMvc.perform(get("/form"))

items.source: Return the underlying DispatcherServlet instance that this MockMvc was initialized with.
items.translation: 返回此 `MockMvc` 初始化时使用的底层 DispatcherServlet 实例。

items.source:
Perform a request and return a type that allows chaining further
actions, such as asserting expectations, on the result.
items.translation: 执行请求并返回一个类型，该类型允许对结果进行链式操作，例如断言期望。

items.source: requestBuilder - used to prepare the request to execute; see static factory methods in MockMvcRequestBuilders
items.translation: requestBuilder - 用于准备要执行的请求； 参见静态工厂方法，位于 MockMvcRequestBuilders

items.source: an instance of ResultActions (never null)
items.translation: 一个 `ResultActions` 实例（永远不会为 `null`）
